messages.subject: Energy Transition Infrastructure Executive | ESG, Stakeholder & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Matthew,

Walter Hewitt's leadership-search focus across renewable infrastructure, investment platforms and operating businesses is highly relevant to my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where infrastructure growth requires strong institutional relationships, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
